findings.title: The 'view uv's version' hint also shows on `--package`, bump and set-version calls.
findings.body: Both discovery paths add the hint for every `MissingPyprojectToml`. That includes the `--package` branch here and calls like `uv version 1.2.3`, `uv version --bump patch` or `--dry-run`. In those cases the user is clearly working on a project, not asking for uv's version, so telling them to run `uv self version` is misleading. Only add the hint when the call is a plain read, with no package, value or bump given. Leave the error unchanged in the `--package` branch.
